title: Byterygon theme
description: A theme for @byterygon/design-tokens: seeds plus overrides. Every seed is optional and takes the default when omitted. `by-tokens validate --theme <file>` is the authority; this schema is for editors and for tools that write theme files.

name.description: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Names the output directory.

colors.description: One ramp per entry. neutral, brand, red, amber, green and blue exist by default; any other name adds a ramp.

radius.description: Corner radius of a standard control, in px.

level.description: WCAG 2.2 level: AA is 4.5:1 text and 3:1 UI, AAA is 7:1 and 4.5:1.

apca.description: Optional APCA minimums (absolute Lc). Without them APCA is reported but not enforced.

overrides.description: Token path to value. A value applies to every mode; an object keyed by mode name (light, dark, comfortable, compact) changes those modes only.

additionalProperties.description: An alias such as {color.brand.11}, or a literal of the token's type: oklch(L C H), oklch(L C H / A), #rrggbb, 12px, 0.75rem, 150ms, a number, a font family or list of families, or a list of shadow layers.

hue.description: OKLCH hue in degrees. Optional for neutral, which then follows the brand hue.

chroma.description: Chroma of the solid step, before gamut mapping.

solid.description: Lightness of the solid step (9) per scheme, for hues that need a light solid (amber, yellow, lime).
